text: No body changes either its direction or velocity other wile than by infentible degrees; therefore the particle which moving the axis will not include the vortex A of the body, where it behaved to deficit influence easily at right angles. It will therefore begin to be diseflected at fromen F is head of the body; and will de-ferible a curve FM, touching the axis in F, and the bo-ly in M, and then, yielding along the body, will gain it at some point I, defening a tangent curve, which will join the axis again (noching it) in B; and thus there will be a quantity of fragment water FAM because or a-head of the body, and another LGR behind or sitem of it.
